qa.title: Q457 (Jan. 31, 2024)
qa.question: If I have 2 copies of this follower on my field, can I activate both their abilities in the same turn?

qa.title: Q456 (Jan. 31, 2024)
qa.question: What does "Add 1 to a Stack on your field" mean?
qa.answer: It means you put a Stack counter on an amulet with Stack on your field.

qa.title: Q455 (Jan. 31, 2024)
qa.question: If I activate this follower's ability once during my turn, can I activate it once more during my opponent's turn?

qa.title: Q454 (Jan. 31, 2024)
qa.question: If I play this follower's activated ability, then banish 10 spells in my cemetery to play Dimension Shift for 7 play points, does it instead cost 3 to play?

qa.title: Q453 (Jan. 31, 2024)
qa.question: If I play this follower's activated ability, then play a spell for 0 play points with Merlin's On Evolve ability, does the next spell I play cost 4 less?
qa.answer: No. The effect of this follower's activated ability applies to the spell you play with Merlin's On Evolve ability.
